name: amount-hint-15cm-pot
description: Watering amount hint for a 15 cm pot: about 350 ml for let_top_dry, shown rounded to 50 ml.
why: Frustum volume: height 0.85 x top diameter, bottom diameter 0.7 x top, frustum volume 1.64 L, soil 90% = 1.48 L. Soil fractions (midpoints): let_top_dry 22.5% = 333 ml, shown as 350. The doc example says 'about 350 ml'. Provisional: the fractions are heuristics without a source.
